references.text: Mockery and scorn from people, and their shaking heads at him, resemble the situation described in Matthew 27:42, where Jesus is mocked and challenged to save himself.
David feels abandoned and mocked, which mirrors how Jesus was mocked and felt abandoned on the cross.
The people and leaders mock Jesus while he is on the cross, parallel to the mockery he receives in Matthew 27:42.
Similar to Matthew 27:42, the priests and scribes mock Jesus by demanding that he save himself from the cross.
